problems.text: The Release run's notes are the deterministic draft: bare ticket summaries and commit subjects written for the loop, not for users
Nothing checks a model's rewrite of release notes, so a Hermes reply could drop the compare link, invent a change or leave out a real one

goals.text: Each release's notes in the version pull request read as user-facing prose without a human writing them
The notes never list a change the release lacks or miss one it holds, and a Hermes failure never blocks a release or empties its notes

outcomes.change: A cleaning script keeps Hermes' rewrite only when it passes the checks, else prints the draft
outcomes.checked_by: `tests/scripts/test_hermes_release_notes.py`, one test per check plus a kept rewrite

outcomes.change: The Release run rewrites the draft with Hermes and commits the checked result as the notes file
outcomes.checked_by: workflow tests pinning the Hermes step's SHA, secret, model, prompt and continue-on-error, and that the notes file comes from the cleaning script's output
